name: broderick
status: SEED v0 — extrapolated from source panels 2026-06-11; refine before render
look: Hand-drawn digital grayscale strip in a faux-devotional register. Loose, confident ink contours over white paper with flat gray bands for sea, mountains, and sky props; sand rendered as white space with sparse squiggle texture; solid-black footprint trails as graphic anchors. Panel one is dominated by calligraphic serif italic narration with an illuminated drop-cap O — greeting-card typography played straight. Panel two drops all text for a wide sight-gag tableau with loose scribble-hatched figures and a hand-scrawled END. Very wide landscape frames, horizon high and flat.
register: absurdist deadpan comedy register; the joke is in the timing and the flatness of the delivery

paper_white.usage: Sky and sand — the beach is mostly untouched white paper with sparse line texture

ink_black.usage: Footprint trails (solid graphic stamps), figure hair/beard, swimsuits, drop-cap, END lettering

sea_gray.usage: Flat dark horizontal band of ocean behind the sand in both panels

mountain_gray.usage: Distant mountain range band, panel one; mid-distance value step

robe_pale.usage: The Lord's long robe and net shadows — lightest wash with scribble-hatch texture

casting_canon.dreamer: Never shown directly; off-screen narrating voice and one set of solid-black footprints in the sand; earnest wounded questioning affect, recites the devotional poem sincerely
casting_canon.the_lord: Adult man with long dark hair and full dark beard, medium build, wearing a long pale ankle-length robe, barefoot; appears only in the wordless punchline panel mid-volleyball-spike at a beach net; serene, absorbed in the game, silent

negatives: photorealistic, photograph, 3d render, cgi, cinematic lighting, lens flare, gradient shading, airbrush, watermark, signature, garbled text, malformed lettering, extra fingers, color, colored fills, painterly sand texture, detailed water rendering, golden-hour sky, halo or glow effects, photoreal anatomy, manga style, dense backgrounds

continuity.comics: Lock each recurring character with a model sheet (front/side/expression strip) before generating strips; restate the full character description in every panel prompt.
continuity.video: Use the locked panel art as the first frame; restate the full character description in every shot.

legal_rule: Specify every character by age, origin, build, wardrobe, and affect only — never by likeness to a real public figure. If a render resembles a real person, regenerate.

failure_fixes.drifts_photoreal: Add: flat hand-drawn grayscale comic illustration, visible ink line, white-paper sand, no photographic rendering, no 3d.
failure_fixes.drifts_reverent: Add: deadpan flat staging, no halo, no glow, no dramatic sky — the gag depends on mundane rendering.
failure_fixes.lettering_garbled: Generate art without text; add calligraphic narration and lettering in post or via dedicated lettering pass.
